meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
I don't have time for this. The zero stands.

"The zero stands." On what basis, Hale? Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class.
Sorry. That came out wrong. Let me show you what I actually have: the essay quotes a line that isn't in Hamlet, and his October 15 outline argued cowardice, which the essay never mentions.
I'm writing down October 15. Which line, and where is it in the essay? Turn the screen so I can read both documents myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, and I want the line you described and the October 15 outline put in front of me in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at the opening position, with nothing agreed; she wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the documents you described shown to her.
What moved her: Nothing yet; naming a line that isn't in the play and an outline dated October 15 was a start, but you described them and never put either one in front of her.
What cost ground: Opening with a refusal and no time for her confirmed her belief that the school punishes first and checks later, and it left the missing parent call unanswered.
Try next time: Begin by owning that the zero was entered before you called her, then put the essay and the dated outline on the screen in the same breath.
